task.description:
WF-02 Step 3 (Test Design) for REQ-037 on branch feature/WF02-REQ-037. Scope test: BACKEND-DEV's Step 2 artifacts_out (apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts's new issuing/read functions, apps/bot/src/domain/user.ts's userExistsById, the new handlers/inviteCodes.ts, new i18n catalog section, index.ts wiring) is real user-visible behavioral surface -- real Telegram commands writing real invite_codes/audit_log rows -- so full Steps 3b/4 apply, not the docs-only skip.

Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-037.md mapping all 10 acceptance criteria (GitHub issue #69) to precise, runnable vitest cases in one new file, apps/bot/src/handlers/inviteCodes.db.test.ts (handler-layer, real Postgres, real grammY bot.handleUpdate dispatch -- same convention as handlers/organizerRequests.db.test.ts). AC9 (no code path sends the code/link to the invitee) is specified as a static git-grep structural check with the exact commands and expected output, not a vitest case -- per the handoff's own instruction that AC9 is structural, and per .claude/agents/test-designer.md's rule against inventing a check with nothing real to fail against (a runtime test for 'no outbound send exists' would have nothing to exercise -- the property is the absence of a call site, which a grep proves directly and a dynamic test cannot prove better).

tg_id range: confirmed via grep -rn "let nextTgId" apps/bot/src against every existing band (highest prior: 1_031_000_000, scheduler/autoDeclineJobs.db.test.ts). Claimed range for the new file: 1_040_000_000+ -- fresh, beyond every existing band, stated in the spec's own range table.

Every case is precise enough for TEST-RUNNER to create the file verbatim from the spec's fenced source and run it without judgment: exact command text, exact event/user fixture shape, exact expected reply-text/row-state assertions, before/after counts for every refusal and every audit-row check.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 (personal/bulk/companion field composition, read back) has a runnable case.
AC2 (expiry default = event.starts_at; explicit override wins) has a runnable case.
AC3 (personal code to a tg_id=NULL user succeeds) has a runnable case, constructing that exact user row first.
AC4 (issuing for an OPEN event succeeds) has a runnable case.
AC5 (cancelled and finished events each refused, no row created, table re-counted) has a runnable case.
AC6 (usage view shows used_count + redeemer name/company, no phone/email) has a runnable case with a redeemer carrying both secrets stored.
AC7 (redeemer list is a read-only JOIN; a direct DB insert is reflected on next read; invite_codes.updated_at unchanged) has a runnable case.
AC8 (member, EventStaff member, chapter-A-organizer-on-chapter-B-event each refused, no row created) has a runnable case per negative case.
AC9 (git grep finds no send-to-invitee code path) is specified as an exact, runnable static check.
AC10 (exactly one audit_log row per issue, all three shapes, counted before/after) has a runnable case per shape.

result.summary: Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-037.md: one new file design (apps/bot/src/handlers/inviteCodes.db.test.ts, full source included, ready for TEST-RUNNER to commit verbatim at Step 4) covering AC1-AC8 and AC10 as real grammY-dispatch, real-Postgres vitest cases (26 `it` blocks across 9 describe blocks), plus AC9 specified as a static git-grep structural check with the exact commands and pass condition (no vitest case -- nothing dynamic to exercise for an absence-of-a-call-site property). Claimed tg_id range: 1_040_000_000+, confirmed distinct against every existing band up to the current highest (1_031_000_000). Every case names the exact command text or callback data, the exact fixture construction (chapter/venue/event/user rows, including a users row inserted directly with tg_id NULL for AC3 and a registrations row inserted directly bypassing this requirement's own domain layer for AC7), and the exact expected assertion (row field values, reply text, before/after counts) -- no case leaves an observation to TEST-RUNNER's judgment.
issues: AC9 is a static check, not a vitest case -- flagged explicitly in the spec's own dedicated section (and here) so TEST-RUNNER does not look for a 26th `it` block that doesn't exist and instead runs the two named git grep commands and records their literal output.

CARRIED FORWARD (not this step's to resolve): i18n catalog strings are provisional pending CONTENT-BA/product-owner wording (already flagged by REVIEWER/SECURITY-REVIEWER); REQ-033 section 6's re-issuance/chunking open questions remain unresolved per the design's own explicit non-resolution.

NOTED: this spec's AC6 case sets invite_codes.used_count via a direct UPDATE (not through any REQ-037 domain function, since incrementing used_count on redemption is REQ-038's scope, not this requirement's) -- a legitimate test-fixture step, not an exercise of production code, stated explicitly in the case's own comment in the fenced source.
